inputs.prompt: TWO-SHOT boss scale concept art for a dark Joseon fantasy isometric ARPG. There are exactly TWO distinct characters: on the LEFT the player hero DOHO, a human Korean wandering swordsman 1.7 meters tall; on the RIGHT the phase-one GUMIHO boss, a huge female fox-human predator. Both stand on the SAME stone floor and SAME camera depth so their physical size difference is honest, not forced perspective. Show the full figures and clear feet on that shared ground plane. Use reference image 1 ONLY for the female gumiho's face, faded navy inn-hostess jeogori, worn pale apron, dark chima, black furred forearms, amber eyes and tails. Use reference image 2 ONLY for Doho: slim adult Korean man, black gat with blue circular bead, navy layered split robe, white collar, red waist sash, blue round pendant, black pants and boots, one plain sword in hand. Do not swap their faces or garments; no other humans. This is PHASE ONE: a brutal physical predator, not a spellcaster. No fire, spirit glow, magic halos or jewelry. No queen gown, armor, crown, fox-ear cosplay or exposed body. The gumiho retains scraps of the same commoner's work clothes as a shocking reminder of her disguise, but her ANATOMY has become enormous and savage: long heavy foxlike spine, powerful hunched shoulders, thick furred forearms and claws bigger than Doho's hands, feral human face with small fangs and tangled hair. Nine distinct massive charcoal fox tails emerge from her lower back and sweep around the arena like muscular limbs, each with an individually legible root and tip. The tails should occupy more screen space than both characters together; they are an attacking body part, not a decorative symmetrical fan. Dust, broken stone and old Joseon seals establish an underground Gumiwon boss arena. Matte hand-painted Korean fantasy key art, hard readable silhouette, ink-edged brushwork, tactile cloth and fur, dark restrained palette and strong size comparison. No duplicate characters, no extra limbs, no split panels, no labels, no text. Make the transformation ANATOMICALLY RADICAL and unmistakably a final boss, not an enlarged woman in a dress. At right a four-limbed, massive quadrupedal fox-human predator charges low across the stone floor. Its arched shoulder ridge is higher than Doho's gat even while crouching; the torso spans the length of three adult humans. The recognizable face of the inn hostess sits at the front of an elongated fox skull, with her familiar alluring eyes now fixed hungrily on Doho; long black hair whips back over a black-furred mane. Exactly two enormous forelimbs retain human-derived clawed hands; exactly two digitigrade hind legs dig into the floor. Shredded indigo jeogori remains caught around the shoulders, and the pale innkeeper apron hangs in torn strips beneath the chest so her former life is still identifiable, but there is NO human skirt silhouette. Nine thick asymmetric tails erupt from a single lower-back root, some smashing pillars and some curling around the tiny hero, each readable as heavy flesh and fur. Doho stands on the LEFT with both boots visible on the same floor line, sword braced toward her; his whole body is visibly dwarfed by her shoulder, skull and attack reach. Showcase this grotesque physical reveal with no flame or magic.
